يستمدوا (form X)
# يَسْتَمِدُّوا (yastamiddū) /jas.ta.mid.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# يُسْتَمَدُّوا (yustamaddū) /jus.ta.mad.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
